mapper.select: SELECT id,name,version FROM nw_agent_templates WHERE id IN #{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_tenants WHERE id=#{tenantId} AND status IN('active','warning'))

SELECT actor_ref,operation,object_scope,request_key,fingerprint,definition_id,result_snapshot::text AS result_snapshot FROM nw_agent_definition_operations WHERE actor_ref=#{actor} AND operation=#{operation} AND object_scope=#{scope} AND request_key=#{key}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_agent_definition_save_fences WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND actor_ref=#{actor} AND operation=#{operation} AND object_scope=#{scope} AND request_key=#{key})
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_agent_templates SET name=#{name},category=#{category}, tags=#{tags,typeHandler=com.skillforge.core.shared.config.JsonbTypeHandler}, description=#{description},icon_url=#{iconUrl}, definition=#{definition,typeHandler=com.skillforge.core.agent.model.AgentTemplateDefinitionJsonbTypeHandler}, price_type=#{priceType},price_cents=#{priceCents},draft_revision=#{draftRevision}, has_unpublished_changes=#{hasUnpublishedChanges},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE nw_agent_templates SET install_count = install_count + 1 WHERE id = #{templateId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_agent_template_publications(template_id, version, snapshot) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{version}, CAST(#{snapshot} AS jsonb))
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot::text FROM nw_agent_template_publications WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND version = #{version}
SELECT snapshot::text FROM nw_agent_template_publications WHERE template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY published_at DESC, version DESC
SELECT p.snapshot::text FROM nw_agent_template_publications p JOIN nw_agent_templates t ON t.id = p.template_id AND t.version = p.version WHERE t.status = 'published' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT p.snapshot::text FROM nw_agent_template_publications p JOIN nw_agent_templates t ON t.id=p.template_id AND t.version=p.version WHERE t.status='published' AND t.distribution_policy='OPEN_INSTALL' ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
